title: A hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin method for the Ostrovsky equation
summary: This paper develops the hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) method for the Ostrovsky equation, a nonlinear dispersive wave equation featuring both third-order dispersion and a nonlocal antiderivative term with Coriolis effect. On a bounded interval, the nonlocal operator $\partial_x^{-1}$ is localized through an auxiliary variable $v$ satisfying $v_x=u$ together with an additional boundary constraint that ensures uniqueness.
